description: Q_β c_3 evaluation comparison: J_Hopf(q=1)=-2 vs J_Hopf(q_0)=-(q_0²+q_0⁻²) at canonical substrate. Reaffirms that Rule A (constant -2) is the only structurally legitimate c_3 since Taylor coefficients of a q-series MUST be q-anchor-independent. The 3.47% 'm_p-pin swing' in PR #1479's deep audit is the c_4 truncation error, NOT evidence that c_3 = -2 is wrong.

data.interpretation: Rule A (c_3 = J_Hopf(q=1) = -2) is q_0-INDEPENDENT — passes the Taylor-coefficient stability test required for a true Habiro coefficient. Rule B (c_3 = J_Hopf(q_0) = -2.044) is q_0-DEPENDENT — cannot be a Taylor coefficient (those are constants). The 3.47% 'swing' between A and B IS the c_4·u⁴ truncation error, BOUNDED per rule 2 of the canonical framing — NOT evidence c_3 is wrong. Per the framing's Rule 4, dashboard should report c_3 = -2 in the 'near-match' tier (still pending Habiro-element identification per the α_EM PR #1511 template).
